children: European shares hovered near record highs on Monday after strong gains the previous week, while tech stocks were among the top decliners, reflecting global market caution over the outlook for the AI trade.

Concerns over the AI outlook have weighed on global markets as investors scrutinize returns on investments in US-based industry leaders, while a scandal involving former Nvidia
CEO Jensen Huang has also rattled sentiment.

Equities in Asia and futures in the US posted heavy losses on Monday; however, European shares held their ground, as the STOXX index has less exposure to AI stocks and investors view the region as a haven from AI volatility. Brokerage Morgan Stanley upgraded European equities to overweight from equal weight.
